experiment: Q38 dense IsoFLOPs and held-out C1

training_comparison.scope: Same target training budget and recorded controls, not an FFN-only ablation or a reproduction of reference training; h/L/Na/D and source training implementations differ

c1_prediction.limitation: N/D power laws do not predict CE or prove that one C1 size is optimal

comparison.hash_serialization: UTF-8 json.dumps(reference, sort_keys=True), default separators and ensure_ascii=True
comparison.change: Replace every main/MTP routed/shared-expert FFN by one dense SwiGLU; other modules unchanged
comparison.budget: Same target compute and reserve, each architecture rounded down to a full global batch

c1_dense.configuration_reference_scope: The comparison metadata within this configuration refers to the corresponding same-shape MoE configuration generated by shape_for, not the measured h448/L9 reference.

evaluation.scope: A100 same-node evaluation; not H200 official score

packed_metadata.bpb_definition: total text-token NLL in nats / (ln(2) * original_text_utf8_bytes); EOS is inserted per nonblank JSONL record but is not scored

protocol.weights_dtype: bfloat16; same implementation and internal FP32 mHC in both models
protocol.timer: CUDA-synchronized forward with full vocabulary projection; sum of per-step rank maximum; exclude H2D, loss scoring, compile/warmup
protocol.bpb: sum text-token NLL /(ln(2)*original UTF8 text bytes); inserted EOS ignored
protocol.normalized_time: forward_seconds / ((Na/1e9)*(scored_text_tokens/1e6)); Na excludes all Embedding and MTP
protocol.comparison_scope: Same FLOPs budget; if extrapolated dense changes h/L/Na, not an isolated FFN-only ablation

protocol.batch_selection: Largest tested power of two passing the complete evaluation; next power fails with CUDA out of memory. Not an exhaustive integer search.
protocol.statistic: Median [min, max] of three complete evaluations of each trained checkpoint; not training-seed uncertainty.
protocol.timer: CUDA synchronize; wall-clock complete model forward including full vocabulary projection; synchronize; sum batches. No distributed process group or GPU-count conversion.
protocol.active_parameters: main-head active parameters, excluding all nn.Embedding and output head; all gates/projections retained. Each token uses fixed top-k, no capacity dropping. MTP not called by main forward.
protocol.bpb: total text-token NLL nats / (ln(2)*original text UTF8 bytes); inserted EOS and pad not scored

evaluation_single_gpu_4090.scope: frozen h448/L9 MoE versus independently trained extrapolated h512/L10 dense, not an FFN-only ablation or equal-quality speedup
evaluation_single_gpu_4090.official_score_scope: C1 measurement adapted from the official single-GPU sample on one RTX 4090 48GB. Hardware differs from the official H200 and only power-of-two batch sizes were searched; the maximum stable integer batch is unverified. Not a C4 or official leaderboard score.
